tools.title: 查看网站
tools.description: List Seenical sites and their non-sensitive configuration in the current App. Use returned site_id values for later operations.

tools.title: 创建网站
tools.description: Create a hosted GitBook site using Seenical Console defaults. Repository credentials and provider tokens cannot be supplied by this Skill.

footer_note.description: Footer disclosure; empty string clears it.

lanying_link.description: Optional public BlueLink URL; empty string disables it.

copyright.description: Copyright text; empty string clears it.

meta_keywords.description: SEO keywords; empty string clears them.

language.description: Single site language used by GitBook UI.

collaborator.description: Optional GitHub collaborator login; empty string clears it.

tools.title: 修改网站配置
tools.description: Partially update non-sensitive site, SEO and publishing settings. Send only requested fields; omitted values remain unchanged and empty strings explicitly clear text fields.

title.description: Document title; empty string clears it.

footer_note.description: Footer text; empty string clears it.

lanying_link.description: Public BlueLink URL; empty string disables it.

copyright.description: Copyright text; empty string clears it.

canonical_link.description: Public HTTP/HTTPS canonical URL; empty string clears it.

meta_keywords.description: SEO keywords; empty string clears them.

icp_number.description: ICP number; empty string clears it.

hook_sentence_slogan.description: Landing slogan; empty string clears it.

hook_sentence_image.description: Public image URL; empty string clears it.

collaborator.description: GitHub collaborator login; empty string clears it.

tools.title: 查看网站统计
tools.description: Read selected site statistics for an optional date range.

start_date.description: Optional inclusive start date in YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: Optional inclusive end date in YYYY-MM-DD.

targets.description: Statistics metric names requested by the user.

tools.title: 查看网站域名状态
tools.description: Read custom-domain configuration and verification state for one site.

tools.title: 检查网站 CNAME
tools.description: Check one site's custom-domain CNAME. When DNS is ready, this updates site state and starts CDN configuration, so user confirmation is required.

tools.title: 查看自定义域名列表
tools.description: List custom domains configured for the current App.

tools.title: 创建自定义域名
tools.description: Create or replace the custom-domain record for one site. Replacing it removes the previous CDN configuration; DNS changes remain the user's responsibility.

domain_name.description: Public DNS hostname without protocol or path.

scope.description: Optional CDN scope; defaults to global.
